pathAssistantSteps.info:
Porcelanosa Staff:

Please check the estimation of the cost and confirm it is acceptable. Then, prepare a quotation for the customer in SAP.

Porcelanosa Staff:

Please enter a brief explanation of the reason why the customer has rejected the installation service.

Porcelanosa Staff

Please enter the sales order and the purchase order number entered in SAP to provide this installation. Then the system will create a Work Order to help you follow up the progress of the installation.

Installer:

Please enter the estimated cost to submit the installation to Porcelanosa for revision

Porcelanosa Staff:

Please fill in all details of the installation and ask the installer to review it

Installer:

To help us improve our service, please enter a brief explanation of the reasons why you have rejected this installation project.

Porcelanosa Staff:

Please enter the number of the SAP quote sent to the customer.

Installer:

Please confirm the visit to the customer has been done and confirm you have all the information you need to estimate the cost of the installation
